issues.description: Class de.tum.in.ase.eist.rest.PersonResource: the constructor in the solution repository declares a parameter of type de.tum.in.ase.eist.service.NoteService and sets the PersonResource.personService field to null (lines 19-21 in the solution). The template repository and the problem statement expect PersonResource to receive a PersonService and assign it to the personService field (template constructor at lines 14-16). This mismatch means the REST resource in the solution does not receive the required PersonService dependency and will leave personService null, causing the endpoints to fail at runtime and confusing students about the intended wiring between the REST resource and the PersonService.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the incorrect constructor in the solution PersonResource with one that accepts a PersonService and assigns it to the field. For example: public PersonResource(PersonService personService) { this.personService = personService; } Remove the NoteService parameter and the assignment of null so the resource is correctly wired to the PersonService as described in the template and problem statement.
